chunks: Yunus, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:

If two men or three kill a man, and they wish to kill them, they shall return the excess of the diyah. And if his awliya' accept the diyah, it shall be upon them; otherwise, they take the diyah of their companion.

key_terms.أَوْلِيَاؤُهُ: his legal heirs or entitled avengers/guardians in the case
key_terms.دِيَةَ صَاحِبِهِمْ: the blood-money of their companion, meaning the compensation related to the slain person
key_terms.فَضْلَ ٱلدِّيَةِ: the excess amount of the blood-money that must be returned or adjusted
key_terms.قَتَلَ: killed; caused the death of another person
key_terms.ٱلدِّيَةِ: blood-money compensation due in a homicide case

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if two or three people jointly kill one person in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding joint homicide when two or three persons kill one man. It explains the options of qisas or diyah for the victim’s awliya' and indicates how compensation is to be adjusted among the offenders.
